# Contract: burned-in-captions

Third-party skill from [xianyu110/ecommerce-video-skills](https://github.com/xianyu110/ecommerce-video-skills) (MIT, xianyu110), `96c49b3`. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Captions and on-screen text burned into a finished video). The method is upstream. Category: video. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Build SRT and ASS captions and burn them into a finished video with ffmpeg, outside platform UI safe zones.

## Use it for
- "burn subtitles into this video"
- "make an SRT and an ASS for this cut"

## Not for
- cutting the footage (rough-cut or vlog-auto-edit)
- a transcript of talking-head rushes (rough-cut)

## Accepted inputs
A finished video and cue timings (JSON), or a script to split into cues.

## Deliverables
subs.ass, subs.srt, and a video with the captions burned in.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

Local only.

## Human decisions
- Which word is highlighted
- Whether the platform will take an SRT instead of burned-in text

## Quality checks
- ffmpeg was built with libass
- A CJK font is installed if the captions need one
- Text is not in the bottom or right UI bands

## Common failures
- No ass filter in this ffmpeg build
- Missing CJK font draws boxes

## Limitations
- Examples are short product videos
